name: Bubble
author: Erin Carter
description: Sparse thin glassy ring outlines rise through open darkness, growing slightly as they climb and carrying a single brighter highlight arc that suggests curved glass. At a hash-determined height each bubble pops — a quick expanding flash that dissolves into a soft fading glow — before re-seeding below the frame. Only the outlines and pop flashes emit light; interiors stay near-black.

params.label: Rise speed
params.effect: Climb rate of every bubble; pop events arrive proportionally more often as it increases.

params.label: Bubble size
params.effect: Base ring radius in CSS pixels at launch; rings grow about 30% beyond this by pop height.

params.label: Waver
params.effect: Horizontal waver amplitude of each rise path in CSS pixels — 0 rises dead straight, 60 weaves drunkenly.

params.label: Pop flash
params.effect: Brightness and spread of the pop burst — 0 makes bubbles silently dissolve, 2 gives bright soft detonations.
